stories.title: Gigi and the Goodbye That Needed a Plan
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!
stories.moral: You can miss a friend and still let them go do their plans.
moralRhyme: Wave goodbye and make a start,
Keep your friend inside your heart!

youtube.description: Gigi asked for one more game as Eli gathered his basket. He had already said he needed to leave. A gentle friendship story. You can miss a friend and still let them go do their plans. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Gigi asked for one more game as Eli gathered his basket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He had already said he needed to leave.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Could we play just one tiny round before you go?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I need to water my garden before the afternoon gets late.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi had loved their long visit at the park.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She wanted the happy part to keep going.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It feels too soon when we are having fun.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I enjoyed it too. I still need to do my watering.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi showed Eli a new game beside the bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He set his basket down for one short explanation.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Look! We could count all the yellow flowers here.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: That would be lovely another time. I need to leave now.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi offered to walk along and keep talking.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Eli looked toward the path leading to his garden.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then I could stay with you for the whole afternoon.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I was planning some quiet garden time by myself today.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Does Eli leaving mean he stopped being Gigi's friend?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi stopped beside the edge of the clear path.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Her throat felt tight where another invitation wanted to come.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I do not like the feeling when a visit ends.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Goodbyes can feel sad even after a really nice visit.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi told Eli she would miss his quiet company.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She kept her feet beside the park bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I want to ask you to stay, but I heard your plan.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Thank you. I do want to spend time together again.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Eli offered another park visit after tomorrow's lunch.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi thought about something they could do then.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Could we look for those yellow flowers tomorrow?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. After lunch, beside this same little bench.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi repeated their plan in her own calm words.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then she moved her basket away from Eli's path.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tomorrow after lunch, at our little park bench.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And today I can go water my garden.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They made a simple goodbye wave beside the gate.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi let it finish without starting another game.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I liked our visit. See you after lunch tomorrow.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I liked it too. Thank you for a lovely afternoon.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: What could help Gigi say goodbye?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Eli walked toward his garden with the little basket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi watched until the path curved beyond the trees.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I still feel a little sad now he has gone.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: She let the sad feeling sit beside the happy memory.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi returned to the bench with her own little basket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She noticed one yellow flower close to its wooden leg.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I can look at this one while I wait for tomorrow.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: She studied its round middle and carefully pointed petals.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi decided to draw the flower for herself.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The quiet page gave her afternoon a small new beginning.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This is something I can enjoy on my own today.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Her pencil made a long stem beneath a small yellow circle.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Back home, Gigi set her flower drawing inside the basket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The visit was over, but its happy parts still mattered.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I can miss Eli and still have an afternoon.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: She walked home carrying the drawing and their simple plan.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi looked at her flower before putting it away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Its extremely long stem almost reached the page's edge.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tomorrow I must ask if flowers can be giraffes.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: The thought gave her a small, unexpected goodbye-day giggle.
lines.speaker: narrator
